describe: Changes to announced schedules, so that a count of sessions to the next scheduled event uses the schedule as it stood on each date. A list of the meetings that were held is hindsight: it omits a meeting that was on the calendar and then withdrawn. The date each year's schedule was first published was not checked; a held meeting is still treated as known in advance.

withdrawn.note: The 17-18 March 2020 meeting was on the calendar until the Committee met on Sunday 15 March and said that meeting took its place. Decisions before 2020-03-15 count down to 2020-03-18.
